item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 5 October 2026

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 5 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade, an airborne brigade, an unmanned systems regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, the Azov Special Forces Brigade, two national guard brigades near Krivorozhye, Andreyevka, Svyatogorovka, Verovka, Belozerskoye, Maryevka in the Donetsk People's Republic, Pervomayskoye, Chuguyevo, and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region) have been hit.
➡️
In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic),
assault groups of the 51st Army advanced in the southern and central parts of the city. Marines advanced in the northern part of the area as well as continued to push the enemy out of the Dobropolskaya mine. Over the past 24 hours, 51 buildings have been liberated and more than 20 AFU servicemen have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, more than 475 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station have been neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group of Forces.
🚩
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance to the depths of the enemy defence and liberated Samoylovka in Zaporozhye region by resolute actions
.
💥
Two air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade have been hit near Tikhoye, Chaplino (Dnepropetrovsk region), Voskresenka, Mirovka, Zalivnoye, Omelnik, Barvinovka, Obshcheye, and Nikolskoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 255 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one counter-fire radar.
↗️
The Dnepr Group of Forces' units took more advantageous lines and positions
. Units of two mechanised brigades and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit close to Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, Kushugum, Grigorovka, and Zapasnoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 40 troops, 16 motor vehicles, and one counter-battery warfare station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on the storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 148 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four guided aerial bombs, one U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectile, and 861 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

item.title: ⚡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ⚡️ Units of the Sever Group of Forces tighten the encirclement around the AFU formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone. 🚩 Fights are underway in the encirclement for the liberation of Varvarovka, Nikolayevka, Lobanovka, and Reznikovo in Kharkov region. Moreover, Russian troops have finished to mop up the small pocket of the encirclement in the area north of Rublenoye (Kharkov region). ▪️ In the encirclement, over 35 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two motor vehicles, and two unmanned ground vehicles have been neutralised during the day. 💥 During the expansion of the external control zone, combat operations are underway near Prikolotnoye, Kotovka, and Annopolye (Kharkov region). 🔥 Moreover, in Kharkov region, manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, an unmanned systems brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Slatino, Svetlichnoye, Pershotravnevoye, Pesochin, Russkiye Tishki, Belashi, Dergachi, and Shestakovo (Kharkov region). 💥 In Sumy region , strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and a territorial defence brigade near Velikaya Chernetchina, Vakalovshchina, Bititsa, and Khomino (Sumy region). ▪️ In total, the enemy lost more than 270 troops, one tank, one armoured fighting vehicle, 24 motor vehicles, one field
item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces
tighten the encirclement around the AFU formations
in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone.
🚩
Fights are underway in the encirclement for the liberation
of Varvarovka, Nikolayevka, Lobanovka, and Reznikovo in Kharkov region. Moreover, Russian troops
have finished to mop up the small pocket of the encirclement
in the area north of Rublenoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
In the encirclement, over 35 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two motor vehicles, and two unmanned ground vehicles have been neutralised during the day.
💥
During the expansion of the external control zone,
combat operations are underway
near Prikolotnoye, Kotovka, and Annopolye (Kharkov region).
🔥
Moreover, in Kharkov region,
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, an unmanned systems brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Slatino, Svetlichnoye, Pershotravnevoye, Pesochin, Russkiye Tishki, Belashi, Dergachi, and Shestakovo (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region
, strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and a territorial defence brigade near Velikaya Chernetchina, Vakalovshchina, Bititsa, and Khomino (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 270 troops, one tank, one armoured fighting vehicle, 24 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one counter-fire radar in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
. Three mechanised brigades, an assault brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Yaremovka, Izyum, Chervony Oskol, Blagodatovka, Osinovo in Kharkov region, Bogorodichnoye, Mayaki, and Volchiy Yar in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 14 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a marine brigade close to Belenkoye, Slavyansk, Semenovka, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, and Kramatorsk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 175 troops, 15 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 Centre 2026: finale of exercise and well-deserved awards An awarding ceremony for participants of the Centre 2026 strategic command post exercise was held
item.description: 🤝 Centre 2026: finale of exercise and well-deserved awards An awarding ceremony for participants of the Centre 2026 strategic command post exercise was held at the Chebarkulskiy training ground. It was attended by Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation General of the Army Yunus-Bek Yevkurov and the command of the Central Military District. 🔹 Servicemen from the armed forces of all states that took part in the manoeuvres were awarded the departmental medal 'For Strengthening Military Cooperation'. 'Thank you very much to everyone - all tasks have been completed, the exercise's objectives achieved,' said Army General Yunus-Bek Yevkurov. #Centre2026 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
